---
title: "'Regarding the Moat'"
author: "Luke Slipski"
date: "2025-01-02"
image: "seabright-beach.jpg"
categories:
  - "Poetry"
---

A kid in camo pants
On the beach
Building Sand Castles
With his Friends

'Regarding the Moat,'
He asks his friend
What if the enemy
Has bioweapons

Why would he know
What those are?
